visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An orange tabby cat is lying flat on top of a professional black audio mixer featuring various colorful backlit pads. A man's hand with a black watch enters the frame from the top left and gently pets the cat's head. The background shows a home studio setup with a red garment on a black chair and a studio microphone. (2) The camera zooms in to a close-up of the cat's head resting directly on the faders and knobs of the mixer. The cat's eyes are drooping in a sleepy expression while the human hand continues to stroke its fur between its ears. (3) The man holds a transparent acrylic cover and slowly lowers it over the mixer. The cat remains motionless as the cover is placed, eventually resting its chin or neck on the edge of the clear plastic. (4) After a brief text transition, the scene changes to show the cat ten minutes later. It is now fully asleep with its face pressed against the side of the mixer, partially sheltered by the acrylic cover in a dimly lit studio environment. (5) A series of extreme close-up shots show the cat's pink paw pads (beans) resting on the smooth surface of the mixer. As time progresses, the paw slowly loses its grip and slides down the vertical surface while the cat remains in a deep sleep.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice speaks softly and gently in Mandarin Chinese, attempting to wake a cat. The background music is a light, acoustic guitar-driven track with a calm vibe. Studio room tone is barely audible. (2) A subtle scuffing sound occurs as a paw moves across the mixer surface. The male voice reacts with a slightly higher pitch and a soft chuckle. (3) Distinct clicking and sliding sounds of hard plastic (acrylic) are heard as a cover is manipulated. A sharp, bright 'Ding' sound effect plays suddenly, creating a brief comedic moment. (4) The BGM transitions into a upbeat, jaunty piano and percussion track with a rhythmic swing. There is no more human speech, only the continuous playful melody as the scene focuses on the cat's deep sleep.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Setup -> Conflict (Obstruction) -> Resolution (Sleeping through it)
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To entertain the audience by showcasing the humorous and adorable behavior of a cat that refuses to wake up and insists on sleeping on professional audio equipment, even when covered by a plastic lid.
